summary: On-demand archival evidence package with signed manifest and SFTP delivery
description: Issue summary: Customer requested a certified archival evidence bundle for legal e-discovery. They require a timebound audit slice for tenant acme-fin-prod for the date range 2026-02-15 to 2026-02-28. The bundle must include: (1) per-event JSON lines audit export, (2) per-tenant redaction applied using the supplied PII mask, (3) an RFC3161 timestamped zip containing the export, (4) a SHA256-signed manifest and checksum file signed with Redwood KMS attestation, and (5) delivery to the customer's SFTP endpoint with mutual TLS and client cert auth. Customer requested confirmation of event ordering guarantees and an MD5/CRC comparison sample against Splunk ingestion.
impact: Customer legal hold: requires evidence for subpoena response. Failure to deliver within requested window escalates to legal and may delay their e-discovery process. High priority for enterprise compliance team.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Validate tenant id and date range (acme-fin-prod, 2026-02-15 -> 2026-02-28). 2) Use archive-service export job with redaction profile provided by customer. 3) Generate NDJSON export and ensure sequence numbers are included. 4) Produce ZIP and obtain RFC3161 timestamp using Redwood timestamping service. 5) Create SHA256 manifest and sign using KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/redwood-evidence-key (attestation screenshot attached in comments). 6) Push to customer SFTP endpoint (sftp.acme-fin.example:22) using client cert tls-prod-acme.pem. 7) Send delivery confirmation and verification checksums to customer security contact.
logs: Export job logs (archive-job-582341) show normal completion: exported 2,154,321 events, compressed size 1.9GB, zip checksum sha256: d2b2...7a9f. Timestamping responded with token 3161-req-9932 and signature present. SFTP session logged SCP-TLS handshake success and 2xx transfer. See support run outputs attached in Confluence link.
investigation_notes:
- Confirmed request scope with CS on 2026-03-10 11:23 UTC.
- Redaction profile applied: removed fields email, ssn, user.message_text per customer mask v3.
- Noted 12 missing sequence numbers in a short window; traced to a transient retry backoff in producer service on 2026-02-20 03:14 UTC. Those events were recovered from cold-tier shard and included in final export.
- Verified RFC3161 timestamp signature chain; timestamp server responded with valid TSA cert chain.
- KMS signing audit shows key used with proper IAM role, rotation in 2025-11 but no emergency rotations since.
- Per-customer ordering guarantee: export preserves stored sequence_number field; we included sequence_number and event_received_at for reconciliation.
